positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Monitor and alert on business applications for on-prem & cloud (AWS) using App Dynamics, Orion, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Develop Python scripts using Selenium to automate site testing for the Choice Hotels website.

Deployed kubernetes clusters for the developing new monitoring tools for operations within the AWS environment using docker containers.

Developed applications to extend in house and 3rd party systems to streamline processes using the api endpoints.

Provided working sessions with our team to train in coding on various languages for automation, troubleshooting, and skills development.

positions.title: Automation Developer
positions.description:
Work in an agile environment to develop, test, and deploy automation jobs requested by the other departments.

Develop utilities to be used by the team to automate existing manual processes.

Perform peer reviews on code written by the other developers to ensure quality and that coding standards where followed.

Use Jira and ServiceNow to track progress and request approvals for deployment to production.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · JavaScript · ServiceNow · Problem Solving

positions.title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Web based applications to automate multiple tasks into a single a process to improve response times.

Develop in house applications to communicate with REST API’s to integrate existing systems together for improved automation.

Monitor network and server infrastructure using solutions such as Orion, PRTG, Stackify, and Grafana.
Develop scripts to automate processes to improve communication response times.

Accomplishments:
Within my first seven months of coming on board with the company I built two web based applications. The first application was a vendor contracts database which made it possible to keep all vendor contracts in a centralized location. This made it easier to keep track of start and end dates for each contract as well as having the option to upload documents created by the vendor. The application was tied to Active Directory security groups allowing administrator to give fine grained access to certain parts of the application.

The second application was web based application which was geared specifically for the network operations team. This was a complete rebuild of an existing application which sent out a communication to specific teams whenever there was an issue that had a certain level of impact. The rebuild of this application made it possible to send out communications faster by having verbiage templates that could quickly be manipulated to the current issue. 

Multiple options would auto-configure depending on the severity of the issue and also target emails to specific groups depending on this severity. Lastly, this application was tied into the internal employee status page API which automatically updated on this communication. For high severity issues, PagerDuty was also tied in to allow automation in calling multiple groups to resolve critical issues.

positions.title: IT Adminstrator
positions.description:
Provide hardware and software support for local and remote campuses through out the multiple states.

Maintain and update Windows Servers and workstations throughout multiple campuses.

Work with management to roll out software and hardware updates throughout all of our locations and traveling to remote locations as needed.

Managed and updated the Linux XenServers servers via ssh and developed Bash files to automate repetitive tasks.

Accomplishments:
Developed an email application using Powershell to run as a scheduled job which picked up a generated report from a designated file share and then delivered it to a manager and executive Exchange distribution list.

Was the primary technician to setup the Linux environment to install, setup, and configure ticketing system. A LAMP (Linux, Apache, Mysql, Php/Perl) setup was configured for the OTRS ticketing system. Back up jobs were scripted in the Bash environment and then configured to be fully automated.

Applied the HTML and CSS markup to re-brand the updated ticketing system to look and feel like it was integrated with the other systems. The branding of the site provided a seamless user experience for both customers and back end technicians.

Spearheaded the Windows 10 imaging process and developed a localized USB solution that took a 45 minute process down to 10 minutes or less. This was achieved by coding the manual process into Powershell files only requiring the technician to pick faculty or student image deployments. The programming in this process automatically decided which software to install depending on the selected image.

Shortly after coming on board, I revised the Windows 7 imaging process to allow for full automation of Windows 7 OS deployments by coding the processes in batch files. This process was then carried throughout 20+ campus locations and proved to be 75% faster prior to joining the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Problem Solving · IIS · REST APIs

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Provide support for 80+ users on Windows based applications such as Windows, XP, MS Office, and Nextgen EMR (electronic medical records).

Configure, update, and maintain Microsoft Active Directory daily for updates and configuration as required for day to day tasks.

Develop windows batch or linux bash scripts to automate user and server tasks to allow for efficient productivity for day to day tasks.

Develop reports by use of either hand-written SQL functions or Crystal Reports as requested by providers, managers, and research groups.

Accomplishments:
Developed payroll program using Linux bash and Mysql for the human resources to take all employee hours, pto, and mileage from the existing time clock application and computed it to a final csv spreadsheet which is then uploaded to Paychex website for biweekly payment of all employees.

Successfully helped the company expand into two sub-leased satellite offices by coordinating with office staff in determining IT infrastructure specifications, coordination of inter-office space use, and final display of company presence through suite directories and display logos.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Problem Solving · IIS · REST APIs

positions.title: Jr. Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Provided tech support for 200+ users on Microsoft applications, call center software (VOIP), and proprietary in house software  via the company ticketing system, email and phone.
 
Built and managed Windows 2003/2008 servers as domain controllers, web servers, and NAS servers.

Administrated user and group permissions through Active Directory.

Modified and updated the existing disaster recovery plan to be in compliance with vendor clients such as Bank of America

Built and maintained the company intranet portal through the Joomla content management system providing a centralized resource for employees and managers to store documentation and to communicate efficiently between departments.

Accomplishments:
During expansion to a new office area, I helped the company save $5000+ by installing the network cabling and configuring the network switches for 50 new workstations.

Built a  LAMP (Linux, Apache, Mysql, PHP) server using Linux Ubuntu Server to develop an inventory system using PHP as the primary programming language. This system tracked the company’s IT assets for keeping documentation of each asset such as purchased serials, location, installed programs, and detailed history.

positions.title: Quality Control Technician
positions.description:
Provided quality control through testing and sieve analysis as determined by the AASHTO And ASTM methods.

Worked closely with operations to configure and optimize production through statistical analysis for quality assurance and to meet county and state guidelines 

In conjunction with plant management, proposed, developed, and assisted with setup of a secondary plant to convert waste aggregate back into a profitable product.

Created reports requested by sales and management for potential job proposals.

Accomplishments:
Was able to prevent a loss of sales and profit in excess of $40,000+ through on-site testing and analysis of materials and making on the spot decisions on whether materials were in specifications.

Was made employee of the month for going out of the scope of the position and providing technical support/remote support to employees in Arizona and New Mexico and working with the IT department in setting up Cisco switches and routers during company expansion.
